# Feature: NPCs & Kreaturen — World Catalog und Packs

<!-- auto-generated by implement for issue #199 -->

## Intent

Welten sollen NPC-/Kreaturen-Content gezielt freischalten können wie Items: Core-/Built-in-Packs, explizite Includes/Excludes sowie world-/personal-owned Definitionen werden über ein `npc-creature-catalog`-Modul zusammengeführt, ohne Definitionen in der Welt zu duplizieren.

## Preconditions

- #196 NPC/creature definitions + persistence (`npc_creature_definitions`, RLS).
- World profiles store `modules` JSONB behind `worldModuleRegistry`.
- UX: `.qa/design/npc-creatures-v1-ux.md` § World Catalog UX.
- Mirror: `item-catalog` (#142) mental model — availability ≠ ownership.

## Happy Path

- [ ] World module ID `npc-creature-catalog` persists config: `enabledPackIds`, `includedDefinitionIds`, `excludedDefinitionIds`, `allowPersonalDefinitions` (default `true`).
- [ ] Pure resolver: union pack defs → includes → excludes (Core never removed) → world-scoped → personal if allowed; dedupe by stable id; Core always present.
- [ ] Built-in packs (Fantasy Basics, Tiere, context packs) + small Core catalog are repository-local (not DB rows).
- [ ] World editor section `NPCs & Kreaturen` toggles packs, search-add includes/excludes, personal switch, live effective count.
- [ ] Separate world-owned authoring list (create/edit/archive/restore) after world is saved; definitions referenced, not embedded in modules JSON.
- [ ] Unknown pack/definition IDs preserved with diagnosis; invalid shapes coerce without breaking other modules.
- [ ] Touched files: zero type escape hatches.

## Edge Cases

- [ ] Empty packs → Core-only (+ world defs + personal per flag).
- [ ] Exclude of Core id is ignored (Core cannot be deactivated).
- [ ] Pack disabled but definition explicitly included → include still present.
- [ ] Deleted/unknown include/exclude ids preserved or skipped with diagnosis.
- [ ] Personal definitions omitted when `allowPersonalDefinitions` is false.
- [ ] Unsaved world shows muted note before world-owned authoring.
- [ ] Empty world catalog remains operable and explains how to enable packs/defs.

## Regression

- [ ] Existing `item-catalog` module, packs, and World UI unchanged and still green.
- [ ] Other WorldModules (species-development) unchanged.
- [ ] NPC library/creator/persistence from #196–#198 remain functional.

## Security Coverage

| Item | Status | How |
|------|--------|-----|
| B-01/B-02 world authz | PASS | Module config via existing world profile edit path; world defs via #196 RLS + canCreate/canMutate |
| Ownership isolation | PASS | Personal cannot elevate into foreign worlds; world writes bind `worldProfileId` from editor |
| Reference validation | PASS | Includes/excludes normalize + diagnose; resolver skips unresolved includes |
| F-05 secrets | N/A | No new secrets |
| P-06 bulk side-effects | N/A | No outbox / external jobs |
